about: Read by tests/tools/run.js. 'failing': suites that fail today for a known reason; the run stays green for them but goes red on any other failure. 'skip': suites that must not run somewhere ('when': 'CI' or 'always'). Every entry carries a reason and a date. Remove an entry the moment its suite passes again (the runner says so).
